summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K announcing FDA approval of Utebzi (tebipenem pivoxil), an oral carbapenem antibiotic for complicated urinary tract infections (cUTIs). No transaction terms (price, stake, premium) are present. The filing is an operational update about a product approval under an existing licensing agreement with Spero Therapeutics. This is a routine regulatory submission, not a special-situation filing. The document reports on clinical trial results and anticipated availability, with no acquisition, divestiture, or other special event. It is classified as a routine current report for a non-US issuer.
